subject.title: Feature: Processing indicator message for Telegram (send ⌛️ while thinking, delete on reply)

question: Should OpenClaw support a standalone Telegram processing-placeholder message, fold this into broader acknowledgement text, or rely on presence/status reactions instead?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but solving it adds Telegram-visible behavior and new config surface that overlaps the open presence PR and the broader acknowledgement-text issue.

options.title: Sponsor Narrow Telegram Placeholder
options.body: Add a default-off Telegram plugin config that sends, tracks, deletes, and edits a standalone placeholder message after an authorized inbound message is accepted.

options.title: Fold Into Cross-Channel Ack Text
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/8285 as the canonical product direction and keep this issue as Telegram-specific context for a broader send-and-continue feature.

options.title: Rely On Presence And Reactions
options.body: Decline standalone placeholder messages and make Telegram responsiveness rely on typing, ack/status reactions, or the open presence PR after its blockers are resolved.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Narrow Telegram Placeholder
recommendation.body: Add a default-off Telegram plugin config that sends, tracks, deletes, and edits a standalone placeholder message after an authorized inbound message is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest sampled current Telegram/config history and already reviewed this exact product/config gap on the issue.
